behavior: make provision NODE=ace2 ENV=staging is idempotent (second run 0 changed) and coexists with the running Ollama service
verification: make provision NODE=ace2 ENV=staging --tags dev_node | tee /tmp/p1 && make provision NODE=ace2 ENV=staging --tags dev_node | tee /tmp/p2 && grep -qE 'changed=0 .*failed=0' /tmp/p2
evidence: 2026-08-06: PASS after the ownership refactor. Two consecutive full runs (TAGS=dev_node): pass 1 ok=29 changed=4 failed=0, pass 2 ok=29 changed=0 failed=0, exit 0 both. No task reports changed on the second pass. The earlier failure (changed=2 forever) was dual ownership: the role injected into ~/.bashrc, ~/.zshrc and ~/.tmux.conf, which setup-linux.sh redeploys wholesale every run. Fixed by writing only to files dotfiles never touches — ~/.bashrc.local + ~/.zshrc.local (the IDEAS-001 seam, sourced last by the tracked rc files) and ~/.tmux.conf.local (new seam, mlorentedev/dotfiles#788) — plus /etc/profile.d/mise.sh. Ownership proof: after pass 2, ~/.bashrc mtime 04:38:21 (rewritten by the bootstrap) vs ~/.bashrc.local mtime 04:37:55 (written in pass 1, untouched). CAVEAT (#863): this proves the ROLE converges. It does not measure setup-linux.sh's own idempotency — that task always runs and its changed_when is bound to the git clone, so its changed=0 is structural, not evidence. Unchanged by this work; still tracked in ANSIBLE-031.

behavior: mise is installed; the global config pins node/go/python; they resolve in a fresh non-login shell
verification: ssh ace2 'bash -lc "mise list" && bash -c "node --version && go version && python --version"'
evidence: 2026-08-06: PARTIAL — the criterion's own command has two halves and they disagree. Login shell (`bash -lc`) PASSES: node/npm/go/python3 all resolve to ~/.local/share/mise/shims with the pinned versions (v24.19.0, go1.26.5, Python 3.12.13). Non-interactive (`bash -c`) FAILS: `node: command not found`. Root cause chain, all fixed except the last: (a) the activation block ran before the dotfiles bootstrap, which deploys its own .bashrc/.zshrc and clobbered it — reordered; (b) `mise activate` is an interactive-only eval — replaced with shims on PATH via /etc/profile.d/mise.sh, scoped to dev_node_user. Remaining gap is not fixable by this role: `ssh host 'cmd'` reads neither profile.d nor .bashrc (Ubuntu's stock .bashrc returns at line 14 on `[[ $- != *i* ]]`). OPEN QUESTION for the human: does 'fresh non-login shell' in this criterion mean interactive-non-login (now passing) or non-interactive (unreachable without ~/.ssh/environment or an explicit shims path in each Ansible task)? Criterion wording needs a decision before this can be marked verified.
